05 / About TARBIZ

A city business centre built around useful space.

Tunku Abdul Rahman Business Centre

A practical platform for work, learning and professional gatherings.

Located along Jalan Tuanku Abdul Rahman, TARBIZ brings together training spaces, corporate event rooms, meeting facilities, creative studio capability and private office suites in one central Kuala Lumpur setting.

The aim is straightforward: provide useful spaces that are easy to access, easy to understand and ready to support real programmes — from small team discussions to larger seminars.

“A place to work, meet, learn and create — right in the city.”
